hero.title: BioResonance
hero.description: A precision tool for scientists and bio-researchers exploring targeted resonance therapy. Load cellular frequency data, compare healthy and target cell signatures, and identify resonance parameters that disrupt target cells while preserving healthy tissue.

cells.sectionSub: Load JSON data sets to begin comparative frequency analysis.

healthy.label: Healthy Cell
healthy.description: Frequency and vibration signature of a healthy cell. Used as the preservation target during resonance tuning.

target.label: Target Cell
target.description: Frequency and vibration signature of the target cell. The primary subject for resonance frequency analysis and disruption.

visualization.title: Big Data Visualization
visualization.description: Render large-scale frequency JSON data sets as interactive graphs and spectral charts.

comparative.title: Comparative Analysis
comparative.description: Side-by-side comparison of healthy vs. target cell signatures to isolate delta frequencies.

targeting.title: Resonance Targeting
targeting.description: Identify precise resonance frequencies that affect target cells without impacting healthy tissue.

profiles.title: Extensible Profiles
profiles.description: Support for multiple cell types, viruses, bacteria, and other organisms as research expands.
